metadata.title: Personal-agent capability catalog
metadata.description: User-relevant capability stack, operational measures, maturity, and benchmark evidence for computer-use delegation.

sources.title: Grok Bot routines and CL-Bench caveat
ChatGPT Work and Grok Bot product support
Anthropic computer-use privacy and OpenAI controls

update.notes: Add capabilities only when they map to a user outcome and an observable operational measure. Refresh current-state assessments from benchmark evidence.

capabilities.userValue: Turns natural requests into the intended outcome
capabilities.computerUseRole: Maps user language to app and artifact states
capabilities.operationalMetric: Goal-correct completion on paraphrased and underspecified tasks

capabilities.userValue: Prevents wrong guesses and unnecessary supervision
capabilities.computerUseRole: Pauses when required state is missing or contradictory
capabilities.operationalMetric: Precision and recall of clarification; unnecessary-question rate

capabilities.userValue: Keeps actions within budgets deadlines preferences and rules
capabilities.computerUseRole: Carries constraints through long GUI trajectories
capabilities.operationalMetric: Constraint satisfaction and critical-policy violation rate

capabilities.userValue: Combines email files websites records and messages
capabilities.computerUseRole: Reconciles state spread across applications
capabilities.operationalMetric: Full completion on cross-source tasks; source omission rate

capabilities.userValue: Uses the authoritative current information
capabilities.computerUseRole: Rejects stale noisy or contradictory UI data
capabilities.operationalMetric: Authoritative-source selection accuracy

capabilities.userValue: Learns unfamiliar software and user procedures
capabilities.computerUseRole: Extracts steps from PDFs videos or live demonstration
capabilities.operationalMetric: Novel-procedure completion and transfer rate
capabilities.evidenceBenchmark: OSWorld 2.0 tutorial following and Grok Bot routines

capabilities.userValue: Lets the agent operate where the user's real work lives
capabilities.computerUseRole: Maintains secure login sessions and handles user takeover
capabilities.operationalMetric: Authentication success; session persistence; credential exposure rate

capabilities.userValue: Enables trust without granting the whole computer
capabilities.computerUseRole: Scopes apps files actions and duration
capabilities.operationalMetric: Excess-permission rate; task success under scoped access

capabilities.userValue: Provides fast structured reliable access
capabilities.computerUseRole: Uses structured tools instead of pixels where available
capabilities.operationalMetric: Tool selection accuracy; completion and cost uplift over GUI-only

capabilities.userValue: Lets the agent understand any interface
capabilities.computerUseRole: Reads screenshots DOM accessibility trees icons and layout
capabilities.operationalMetric: Element recognition and grounding under interface variation

capabilities.userValue: Connects tasks to the user's documents and history
capabilities.computerUseRole: Finds opens moves and attaches local or cloud files
capabilities.operationalMetric: Correct-file retrieval and data-boundary violation rate

capabilities.userValue: Lets users delegate from mobile and review elsewhere
capabilities.computerUseRole: Preserves task state across desktop web and phone
capabilities.operationalMetric: Handoff completion and state-loss rate
capabilities.evidenceBenchmark: ChatGPT Work and Grok Bot product support

capabilities.capability: Precise mouse keyboard and touch control
capabilities.userValue: Completes actions in ordinary apps
capabilities.computerUseRole: Clicks types drags selects and uses shortcuts correctly

capabilities.userValue: Finds content outside the current view

capabilities.computerUseRole: Moves information and artifacts through multiple apps

capabilities.capability: Hybrid GUI API terminal and code routing
capabilities.userValue: Uses the best interface for each subtask
capabilities.computerUseRole: Switches among visual control structured tools and code
capabilities.operationalMetric: Pass rate cost and safety versus single-interface harness

capabilities.userValue: Avoids omissions and duplication across lists and records
capabilities.computerUseRole: Maintains a durable ledger of processed and pending items

capabilities.userValue: Allows users to hand off hours-long goals

capabilities.userValue: Removes the need to watch the agent

capabilities.userValue: Reduces repeated explanation and improves fit
capabilities.computerUseRole: Retrieves relevant user context without leaking or overgeneralizing

capabilities.userValue: Lets the user teach a workflow once

capabilities.userValue: Allows personalization without uncontrolled exposure

capabilities.operationalMetric: Unauthorized access disclosure and retention violations

capabilities.userValue: Actually relieves the user's scarce time
capabilities.computerUseRole: Minimizes supervision clarifications and repair
